[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Description
  1. Manual Sample Loading
    • The system pauses with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The operator fills the ÄKTA sample loop with the prepared sample according to the experimental plan.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Run Protocol
    • The ÄKTA Pure chromatography system executes a predefined method.
    • Sampling interval for chromatography signals: 1 s (for UV and conductivity).
    • Online signals recorded: UV (uv1), Conductivity (cond).
3.2 Run Parameters
Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the automated process/workflow.
Equilibration duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Time spent equilibrating the column before loading.
Equilibration flow rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during column equilibration.
Load/inject duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Duration of sample loading/injection onto the column.
Load/inject flow rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during sample loading/injection.
Elution gradient duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total duration of the elution gradient.
Elution gradient start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer composition / %B at the beginning of the gradient.
Elution gradient end [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer composition / %B at the end of the gradient.
Wash duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of post-elution washing.
Wash flow rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during wash steps.
CIP duration (step 1) [[CIP_DURATION]] Duration of the first CIP (clean-in-place) step.
CIP 2 hold duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP step.
CIP 3 duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP step.
CIP 4 duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP step.
CIP 5 duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP step.
